scope: engineering only; scripted fixture, no terminal
checks: loading is read-only, works before a checkpoint exists and skips a half-written last call
the feed groups decisions under day, time and place headings and wraps to the panel width
the speech-only toggle and the one-person filter narrow the feed
header, footer and people panel fit any width from 40 columns; clock shows day and time

the engine view shows each model call's input and output (recalled memories, speech, repeat re-asks, repairs), reads the call log incrementally without half-written lines, and the status line shows the call in flight, pace and time left
run_live writes the call in flight to current.json and removes it when the call ends, including failed calls
run_live records each call's prompt/output tokens, generation speed and finish time
graphs show output/prompt tokens and calls per minute, generation speed and seconds per call, how each person's days felt, and what runs now and next; older runs without token logs say so
the phone-call view merges your lines with the person's replies in order and shows a new call as waiting to ring; a face-to-face talk shows your opening line, their silence and how to walk away
key h opens a talk guide listing this run's people first, with examples for talking, calling, sending a character, /auto and /bye, wrapped to the panel width; the footer shows h help

the character panel shows the face, feelings, and hormone and need bars only when those modules are on; the room map lists every person once in their room with the selection marked; the web uses only the picked person's own relationship records
every menu choice writes exactly the inbox note its typed command writes; an introduction carries its relationship
